rules.title: Annual Adjustment of Relocation Assistance Payments for Owner Move-In and Ellis Act Evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords who evict tenants through an owner move-in eviction or an Ellis Act eviction (removing the property from the rental market) must pay tenants relocation assistance, with the amounts adjusted each year for inflation.
rules.key_value: $19,413 standard relocation payment; $6,471 additional payment for qualifying households
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to tenants displaced by owner move-in evictions or Ellis Act (no-fault) evictions in Berkeley.
rules.citation: Berkeley Mun. Code ch. 13.76 (Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance; Ellis Act Implementation Ordinance)
rules.quoted_span: These increases represent a 1.5% upward adjustment in the previous amounts, which is the 12-month increase in the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers in the San Francisco-Oakland-San Jose region.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the household qualifies for the additional relocation assistance payment (e.g., low-income, senior, disabled, or similar qualifying status)
